title: Boreal Soil Carbon Dataset, 2022–2026
intro: Plot-level soil carbon measurements, fungal continuity scores and supporting metadata from the boreal transect study. Released under CC BY 4.0.

add_content_to_page.add_paragraph: The archive contains the labelled-core measurements, the plot survey, the calibration log and the analysis scripts used in the paper. Every table is provided both as CSV and as a documented R data frame. Column names follow the paper's supplementary glossary.

add_table.heading: Files in this release

add_special_note.heading: How to cite
add_special_note.text: Carter, M., Mendoza, C., & Park, M. (2026). *Boreal Soil Carbon Dataset, 2022–2026* (Version 1.2) [Data set]. doi:10.5281/zenodo.14231884

add_items_to_list: **Sampling** — 36 plots, two depths, four annual campaigns.
**Labelling** — 13C pulse labelling at a subset of eight plots.
**Fungal score** — visual hyphal continuity index, three observers.
**Uncertainty** — reported as standard deviation across cores.
**Coverage** — two latitudes only; sandy soils under-represented.
**Seasonality** — spring campaigns only; winter stocks not sampled.
**Observer effect** — fungal scores carry a ±1 index-point spread.
